title: Flash priority matrix — cross-team quick hits (Mar 2027 Week 12)
summary: One-page, lightweight tracker to surface high-impact quick actions across Eng / Product / SRE / CS for the coming 4 business days. Use this file for rapid handoffs and status check-ins (not a permanent backlog).
body: How to use: 1) Add one row per discrete quick hit (<= 2 engineer-days). 2) Keep 'Next action' specific (PR link, assign, escalate). 3) Update status by EOD and ping owner in #ops-weekly. Triage rules: red = blocks revenue or customer SLA; amber = degrades perf/cost materially; green = low risk. --- Notes to self: Keep this short; move anything >2d to product backlog and link JIRA. Slack pings: @liam, @ayes, @diego for escalations.
rows: Header | Owner | Team | Priority | Impact (who) | Est effort | Current blocker | Next action | Due

Embedding cache TTL miscount | Ayesha Patel | serving-runtime | High | Cost spike for 3 dedicated customers (~$1.4k/day) | 0.5d | missing unit test surfaced in deploy | Patch + hotfix PR -> GH#8123; deploy canary to dedicated pool | 2027-03-19

Canary latency regression (95p) | Liam O'Connor | observability/serving | High | Hosted API 95p latency up from 320ms->520ms | 1d | noisy async batch path on prod nodes | Rollback latest kernel selection; create short repro trace; follow-up perf PR | 2027-03-19

Quota alarm for Partner X | Rachel Kim | customer-success / platform-eng | High | Partner X throttled during peak ML job window | 0.25d | alerting thresholds mismatched to burst policy | Increase quota temporarily; file JIRA-5128 for policy fix; notify partner | 2027-03-18

KV cache LRU edge case | Diego Martinez | serving-runtime | Medium | Occasional stale prefix on multi-tenant hosts | 1.5d | race condition repro required | Add additional locking + unit tests; run stress job on staging | 2027-03-23

VPC quickstart doc gap | Maya Chen | product/private-deployments | Low | New POC stuck on setup step 4 | 0.25d | missing example for KMS integration | Add one-paragraph snippet and example commands; link to private-deployments/confluence | 2027-03-19

Billing micro-anomaly (Mar 16) | Finance ops | finance-and-legal | Medium | Small mismatch in usage rounding for embeddings | 0.5d | unclear mapping in billing export | Quick diff of export vs. billing table; escalate if >$500 | 2027-03-20

Docs code sample broken (SDK v0.12) | Ayesha Patel | developer-experience | Low | New users hitting import error in quickstart | 0.25d | older example pinned in TOC | Update sample and publish patch release notes; notify docs-subscribers | 2027-03-19

Transient Dedicated capacity warning | Platform eng oncall | dedicated | Medium | Autoscale briefly failed during spike -> degraded throughput | 0.75d | mis-sized pool for region eu-west-1 | Increase burst capacity config + add test harness for spike | 2027-03-21
follow_up: End-of-day checklist: owners update status in this sheet; uncompleted items either escalated or moved to product backlog with reason. Quick call if two or more red items remain. Archive this doc after Friday close and create a new sheet for next week.
freeform_notes: Scratchpad: Maya to ping @cloudinfra for the autoscale test; Liam will attach flamegraphs to the canary ticket; Diego to attempt a 3-node repro with synthetic KV workload. Remaining questions: do we want automatic stitching of this sheet into weekly retro? (pros: visibility; cons: noisy).
